description: Check a BIMI record (the DNS TXT record that points mail receivers to a brand logo) before it is published. Send the record text, and optionally the domain's DMARC record. Get back whether receivers read it, the logo address (one https address, SVG or SVGZ), the evidence (Mark Certificate) address, avatar preference, local-part prefixes, whether it is a declination record, each problem with its draft section, and whether the DMARC policy is strong enough for BIMI (quarantine at 100% or reject, subdomain policy not none, test mode). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/bimi-record-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

author_is_subdomain.description: Optional: true when mail is sent From a subdomain (news.example.com), so the DMARC subdomain policy sp counts too. Default false.

dmarc_record.description: Optional: the DMARC TXT record of the Organizational Domain (starting v=DMARC1), to check whether its policy allows BIMI.

domain.description: Optional: the domain the record is for, to show the DNS name to publish at.

record.description: The BIMI TXT record text, starting with v=BIMI1 (several strings of one TXT record joined without spaces).
